line.title: LINE news bot
line.description: People send a news link, text or a picture to the bot in LINE. The bot finds the CVEs in it and answers which devices of which organization are affected.
line.webhookHelp: If LINE already sends this bot's events to another system, have that system forward each request unchanged (same body, same X-Line-Signature header) to this URL. Otherwise paste it into the LINE Developers console (Messaging API, Webhook URL) and turn on Use webhook. It must be reachable over HTTPS.
line.keep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
line.secretHelp: From the LINE Developers console. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
line.chatsHelp: One chat ID per line: the groups or one-to-one chats whose messages the bot reads. The bot stays silent in every other chat. In these chats it reacts only to links, CVE ids and pictures. To find a chat's ID, add the bot to it and type /chatid.

errors.missing_secret: Enter both the channel secret and the channel access token.
errors.invalid_chat: A chat ID may only contain letters, digits, - and _.
errors.invalid_forward: The address to pass messages on to must be a full https address without a user name or password, and not this portal's own address.

line.recentNote: The last 20 messages the bot analysed.
line.empty: No message has reached the bot yet.
line.answerChatHelp: The group the bot sends its answers to. The answers name organizations and devices, so use an internal SOC group, never a customer's, and not a group another system already uses. Leave empty to answer in the chat the news came from. The bot must be a member of this group.
line.forwardUrl: Pass LINE messages on to another system
line.forwardUrlHelp: Use this when the LINE webhook points at this portal but another system (for example the SOC dashboard) must still receive every message. Each request with a valid signature is sent on unchanged, so that system checks it as if LINE called it. Leave empty to switch off. Must be an https address.
line.forwardNoConn: Last pass-on {time}: could not connect to the other system
line.forwardFail: Last pass-on {time}: the other system answered with code {status}
